flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/App.tsx, src/i18n/en/translation.json, src/utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts, src/utils/models/Icourtcase.d.ts, src/pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx,hook/useSearch.ts,hook/useSearchParams.tsx,list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx}, src/pages/Notice/{context/NoticeContext.tsx,form/History.tsx}, src/pages/Report/{index.tsx,action/ActionReport.tsx}, src/utils/config/env.ts. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/OcmsCourtCase.java (3 columns) and workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController (inbound CAS, not credited). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no court document upload code
note: The court document upload epic has no code in the six repos. Only leftovers exist in ocmsadminui: the label 'Court Upload Documents' in translation.json:105-106, the file rule court_upload_doc (10 MB, Document) in ValidFile.ts:182-185 which no component uses, the Icourtcase type (doc_type, file_name, b_lob, send_to_sc_flag) in Icourtcase.d.ts:41-49 with no upload user in the UI, and an empty '{/* COURT */}' block in App.tsx:313. The OcmsCourtCase entity in ocmsadminapi has only 3 columns (notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason; OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31) and is used by the inbound CAS endpoints (CasIntegrationController), not for document upload; the CAS endpoints are not credited because no step of this story matches them. State Courts SFTP/batch is not in the six repos (earlier court epic finding). The status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)' is a sheet claim; the code does not support it. There is no court detail page, document type choice, upload component, or confirmation step. One leftover exists in the notice History tab (History.tsx:71-171, resource courtcase) which is active only when isAPIFound (STAGING or LOCAL; env.ts:11) and uses a courtcase endpoint that has no controller in ocmsadminapi, so it is not credited. The OcmsCourtCase entity has no defendant or complaint_no columns.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. All steps (court detail, defendant detail, document type, upload, confirmation) are missing.

steps.step: OCMS displays the court case/mention/warrant details for the searched number
steps.detail: There is no court detail page for the upload flow. The 'Court Application History' grid in History.tsx:71-80 uses resource 'courtcase' only when isAPIFound (STAGING or LOCAL; env.ts:11); in production the resource is empty. In the backend OcmsCourtCase has only 3 columns (OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31), there is no courtcase, courtmention, courttrial or warrantofarrest controller in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi, and the grid columns (complaint_no, csd_batch_date, batch_status) are not in the entity. Treated as a stub, not a working court case feature.

The fields defendant_id, defendant_id_type, defendant_name exist only as a type in Icourtcase.d.ts:12-14 and no component renders them; there is no defendant column in the backend entity (OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31). The general Notice page shows owner/driver, but that is not court defendant data and is not credited.

steps.step: OCMS prompts the officer to select the document type (for example mention slip)
steps.detail: There is no document type choice. doc_type is only a type field at Icourtcase.d.ts:49 with no user; 'mention slip' does not appear in the code of the six repos.

There is no court file upload component. The court_upload_doc rule (10 MB, Document format) in ValidFile.ts:182-185 is used by no component (grep: definition only). There is no court file receiving endpoint in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. The uploads that exist (notice number upload in NoticeSearch/page/upload, OffenceAttachment) serve other functions and are not credited.
There is no confirmation step because there is no court upload page (the COURT block in App.tsx:313 is empty).
